keys.tut.confirmRestart: Start the tutorial? The current round will be lost
keys.tut.handoff.action: Clear all the cards on the board
keys.tut.handoff.rule: No match? Draw from the deck. You can undo a move or ask for a hint at any time.
keys.tut.hintContinue: Read the explanation, then tap Continue to begin.
keys.tut.intro.rule: Match every move to this card. It’s 7 now; each card you play replaces it.
keys.tut.s1.action: Go one higher OR one lower
keys.tut.s1.rule: On 7, play a 6 or an 8. Choose a face-up card with nothing covering it. Tap the 8.
keys.tut.s2.rule: There’s no uncovered 7 or 9 on the board. Tap the deck to replace the face-up card.
keys.tut.s3.action: The new face-up card is a King (K)
keys.tut.s3.rule: An Ace (A) also fits a King. Tap the Ace to place it on the King.
keys.tut.s4.action: An Ace also connects to 2 — tap the 2
keys.tut.s4.rule: On an Ace, you can play a King or a 2. It works both ways: an Ace fits either.
